name: تحديد متى يكون على الأقل واحد من المتغيرات البولينية الثلاثة خاطئ
description: انشئ برنامجًا يحدد ما إذا كان على الأقل أحد المتغيرات البولينية الثلاثة خاطئة بناءً على القيم التي يستقبلها من المستخدم.
code:
#Khatwa 1: Iqra madkhal almustakhdim li qimat al-mutaghayyir al-booliny al-awwal (al-mutaghayyir a)
text = input("Adkhil 1 idha kanat qimat al-mutaghayyir al-booliny al-awwal (al-mutaghayyir a) hiya True, wa in lam takun f adkhil 0:")
input_num = int(text)
#Khatwa 2: Taayyin ma idha kanat qimat al-mutaghayyir al-booliny al-awwal (al-mutaghayyir a) True
if input_num == 1 :
    a = True
else:
    a = False
#Khatwa 3: Iqra madkhal almustakhdim li qimat al-mutaghayyir al-booliny al-thani (al-mutaghayyir b)
text = input("Adkhil 1 idha kanat qimat al-mutaghayyir al-booliny al-thani (al-mutaghayyir b) hiya True, wa in lam takun f adkhil 0:")
input_num = int(text)
#Khatwa 4: Taayyin ma idha kanat qimat al-mutaghayyir al-booliny al-thani (al-mutaghayyir b) True
if input_num == 1 :
    b = True
else:
    b = False
#Khatwa 5: Iqra madkhal almustakhdim li qimat al-mutaghayyir al-booliny al-thalith (al-mutaghayyir c)
text = input("Adkhil 1 idha kanat qimat al-mutaghayyir al-booliny al-thalith (al-mutaghayyir c) hiya True, wa in lam takun f adkhil 0:")
input_num = int(text)
#Khatwa 6: Taayyin ma idha kanat qimat al-mutaghayyir al-booliny al-thalith (al-mutaghayyir c) True
if input_num == 1 :
    c = True
else:
    c = False
#Khatwa 7: Uktub al-taabir al-booliny litaayyun ma idha kan 'ala alaqal wahid min al-thalatha mutaghayyirat ghair sahih
result = not (a and b and c)
#Khatwa 8: Ataa natija
if result == True :
    print("Naem! Ala alaqal wahid min al-thalatha mutaghayyirat al-booliny ghair sahih.")
else:
    print("La! Laisa hunak ay mutaghayyir min al-mutaghayyirat ghair sahih.")
